decisive_passage: 12.3 Before Final Completion, the Subcontractor shall deliver to the Contractor: (a) two printed sets and one electronic set of operation and maintenance manuals; (b) record drawings showing the as-built location of all concealed ductwork, piping, valves, and dampers; (c) the final, approved testing, adjusting, and balancing report; (d) all manufacturers' warranties; (e) signed training attendance records; and (f) the Subcontractor's verified reports and other documents required by DSA for the Subcontract Work.
